patch_description: Add a shared mid-layer RZ gate on all nine qubits immediately before the ZZZ block. This mirrors the successful architecture from the first program and provides global phase injection right before the most expressive three-qubit interactions. The shared parameter "rz_mid" adds only +1 parameter and +1 depth while enabling better coordination of collective three-qubit correlations. This should reduce the current generalization gap (0.09) and improve test accuracy by tightening control over the circuit's most expressive layer.
